Fixed calc.py; all tests pass ("ALL PASS"). Changes:
- mean: removed the erroneous `+ 1`.
- median: now averages the two middle values for even-length lists (previously returned the upper middle element, e.g. median([4,1,3,2]) was 3 instead of 2.5).
- clamp: swapped the min/max arguments — it was `max(hi, min(lo, x))`, which returned hi for any in-range x; now `max(lo, min(hi, x))`.

Created /workspace/textstats/textstats.py with word_freq(text, top=3): it lowercases, extracts words ignoring punctuation via regex, counts with Counter, and sorts by count descending then alphabetically for ties. Added /workspace/textstats/test_textstats.py with 6 unittest cases (basic counts, case-insensitivity, punctuation, alphabetical tie-breaking, top parameter, empty text). All 6 tests pass (python3 -m unittest, OK).
